text.line.m.a1.08.gate: That is the depot gate. Get one clear photo of the plates on the fence and the sensor racks behind them.
text.line.m.a1.08.lurk: Quiet now. The mapping cars come by on the hour. Listen for the hum.
text.line.m.a1.08.patrol: The depot called it in. A patrol is on you. Lose it and head for home.
text.line.m.a1.08.plant: A second car is leaving the depot. Pull up close and hold there. My dongle only needs a few seconds of the bumper.
text.line.m.a1.08.planted: Dongle is in. That car will now tell us where it has been. Get out of there.
text.line.m.a1.08.scanner.1: They map the same blocks every night. Tonight we map them back.
text.line.m.a1.08.start: Patch here, on the encrypted line. The Halcyon mapping cars run dark at night. Get a car and wait by the Yard gate.
text.line.m.a1.08.tail: There it goes. Stay back, stay in sight, and do not let it lose you.
text.mission.m.a1.08.fail.ride: Your car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.chase_scanner: Pull up close to the second mapping car
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.enter_ride: Get a car and wait at the Yard gate
text.mission.m.a1.08.obj.follow_scanner: Follow the mapping car to its depot
text.mission.m.a1.08.title: Dead Pixels
